newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Caliber System estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Caliber System estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Monday it reduced its earnings estimate for Caliber System Inc in 1997 to $1.00 from $1.40.
-- Gruntal said the stock may be suitable for value-based, risk-tolerant portfolios, but cannot be recommended until confidence builds on a turn for the better.

-- Caliber reported fourth-quarter earnings well below analysts' consensus estimates of $0.20, although the company forsees better growth and profitability at Roadway Packaging Services in the months ahead, Gruntal said.
-- Caliber is the parent of Roadway, Viking Regional Group, Roberts Express and CBB Logistics.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/4 Monday at 20-3/8.
